question: CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS BORN ON 28 OCTOBER 1909?
CLAUDIE BOURDET DIED ON 20 MARCH 1996?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS A SON OF THE DRAMATIC AUTHOR ÉDOUARD BOURDET AND THE POET CATHERINE POZZI?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS BORN AND DIED IN PARIS, FRANCE?
IN 1935, CLAUDIE BOURDET MARRIED IDA ADAMOFF?
CLAUDIE BOURDET LEFT THE SWISS FEDERAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY ZURICH WITH AN ENGINEERING DIPLOMA IN TECHNICAL PHYSICS IN 1933?
CLAUDIE BOURDET UNDERWENT MILITARY SERVICE IN THE ARTILLERIE DE MONTAGNE?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS PUT IN CHARGE OF A MISSION FOR THE ECONOMY MINISTRY DURING THE GOVERNMENT OF THE FRONT POPULAIRE?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS ACTIVE IN FRENCH RESISTANCE MOVEMENTS?
CLAUDIE BOURDET PARTICIPATED IN THE FOUNDATION OF THE RESISTANCE NEWSPAPER COMBAT ALONG WITH HENRI FRENAY?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS A MEMBER OF THE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE OF COMBAT UNTIL THE DEPARTURE OF FRENAY TO LONDON AND LATER ALGERIA IN 1943?
WHEN WAS CLAUDIE BOURDET MADE THE REPRESENTATIVE OF COMBAT AFTER FRENAY'S DEPARTURE IN 1943?
CLAUDIE BOURDET TOOK PART IN THE CREATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF THE NEWSPAPER COMBAT FROM 1942 WITH THE TASK OF DIVIDING THE PUBLIC ADMINISTRATIONS?
IN 1944, CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS ARRESTED BY THE GESTAPO?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS IMPRISONED AT FRESNES AFTER BEING ARRESTED BY THE GESTAPO?
CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS DEPORTED TO VARIOUS CONCENTRATION CAMPS INCLUDING NEUENGAMME, SAHSENHAUSEN, AND BUCHENWALD?
AFTER THE WAR, CLAUDIE BOURDET CONTINUED TO WRITE AT COMBAT BUT HIS CONFLICT WITH HENRI SMADJA, THE OWNER OF THE NEWSPAPER, RETURNED AND HE LEFT THE PUBLICATION IN 1950?
IN 1950, CLAUDIE BOURDET FORMED L’OBSERVATEUR WITH THE HELP OF GILLES MARTINET AND ROGER STÉPHANE?
L’OBSERVATEUR BECAME L’OBSERVATEUR AUJOURD’HUI IN 1953?
L’OBSERVATEUR BECAME THE FRANCE-OBSERVATEUR IN 1954?
CLAUDIE BOURDET DEFENDED THE UNION OF THE LEFT AND SOCIAL JUSTICE?
CLAUDIE BOURDET SUPPORTED THE ANTI-COLONIAL FIGHT, DENOUNCING REPRESSION IN MADAGASCAR AND TORTURE IN ALGERIA?

IN 1961, CLAUDIE BOURDET INVESTIGATED AND DENOUNCED MAURICE PAPON, THE PREFECT OF THE POLICE FORCE, IN CONNECTION WITH THE SHOOTINGS OF ALGERIAN FLN DEMONSTRATORS ON 17 OCTOBER OF THAT YEAR, IN THE PARIS MASSACRE OF 1961?
CLAUDIE BOURDET'S POLITICAL MILITANCY CREATED TENSIONS WHICH LED TO A MAJOR RuptURE OF THE FRANCE-OBSERVATEUR TEAM IN 1963 AND HIS SUBSEQUENT DEPARTURE FROM THE NEWSPAPER?
CLAUDIE BOURDET CONTINUED TO PUBLISH ARTICLES IN TÉMOIGNAGE CHRÉTIEN, POLITIQUE HEBDO OR POLITIS, AND TOOK PART IN THE SPECIAL NUMBERS OF THE NOUVEL OBSERVATEUR?
IN 1985, CLAUDIE BOURDET WAS A MEMBER OF THE "JURY OF HONOR" THAT ASSESSED WHETHER THE FILM DES TERRORISTES À LA RETRAITE SHOULD BE Aired IN FRANCE OR NOT?
THE "JURY OF HONOR" IN ITS REPORT STATED "THOUGH IT IS HIGHLY DESIRABLE THAT A FILM INFORM FRENCH OF ALL GENERATIONS ABOUT THE SAGA OF THE FTP-MOI, SUCH A FILM NEVERTHELESS STILL REMAINS TO BE MADE"?
CLAUDIE BOURDET CALLED THE FILM "RACIST AND ANTI-SEMITIC"?
